items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI launches tomorrow, November 19
items.en_title: Grand Theft Auto VI launches tomorrow, November 19
items.en_oneliner: PlayStation confirms GTA VI arrives November 19, as Jason and Lucia find themselves on the darkest side of the sunniest place in America after a score goes wrong.

items.title: 8BitDo Reveals Its Own GameCube Controller For Switch 2
items.en_title: 8BitDo Reveals Its Own GameCube Controller For Switch 2
items.en_oneliner: Known for retro-inspired controllers, 8BitDo announced a GC Bluetooth Gamepad for Switch 2, priced below Nintendo's official version.
